criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 11 March 2028 (18 months after the 11 September 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $159,650,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $159,300,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the long-stop date as 8 November 2026 (150 days after signing on 11 June 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 8 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (11 March 2028), with days remaining from 3 July 2026 (617 days).
Notes that 11 March 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 13 March 2028.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
